brief:
Israeli occupation authorities have expelled a 10-member British security team that was conducting training operations for Palestinian Authority security personnel in the occupied West Bank, according to the Shehab Wire. The team had been engaged in capacity-building work with various Palestinian security agencies across the territory.

The expulsion was reported by the British newspaper Telegraph, though the specific timing of the removal and Israel's stated justification for the action have not been detailed in available accounts. The departure marks an end to the British advisory mission supporting Palestinian security force development in the West Bank.
